independence_statement: Sonnet owner submission uses only modelapi synthetic fixtures. Real dataset shards, reward labels, peer owner outputs, and filesystem/network IO were not read.

implemented: frozen grid search k[16,32,64] x feature_set[required_only,required_plus_optional], seed 42
self-symbol embargo: exact self-event exclusion plus a 24h decision-time purge window
hash-priority (seed-bound) tie-break for neighbor selection, vote ties, and grid-attempt ties
data-independent candidate pool capped at 8192 rows, frozen by seed-42 hash priority independently of input order
data-independent embargoed LOO pseudo-query set capped at 1024 rows from the frozen candidate pool
bounded, aggregated neighbor evidence summary and reason string per prediction
append-only attempt ledger over the embargoed leave-one-out grid search

search_space.distance: missing-aware standardized (z-score) mean-squared distance; a missing feature on either side contributes a fixed, data-free penalty instead of an imputed value
search_space.neighbor_weight: inverse distance, epsilon-stabilized so an exact match dominates a merely nearby one
search_space.vote: distance-weighted mean for the continuous fraction (snapped to the frozen signed-position grid), plus distance-weighted mode with hash-priority ties for horizon/delay
search_space.selection_objective: embargoed leave-one-out mean loss over at most 1024 seed-42 hash-priority pseudo-queries from the frozen candidate pool: squared fraction error + horizon mismatch + delay mismatch

complexity_upper_bound.fit_pool_freeze: O(n log n) one-time deterministic ordering, retaining at most 8192 rows
complexity_upper_bound.fit_grid_scoring: O(6 * 1024 * 8192 * feature_dims), independent of input size n after pool freeze
complexity_upper_bound.predict: O(8192 * feature_dims), independent of input size n

feature_sets.required_only: 23 of the 25 frozen market features, excluding the dataset's own documented optional feed features (rubik_taker_ratio, rubik_ls_ratio), plus the 4 decision-time account (local-state) features
feature_sets.required_plus_optional: all 25 frozen market features plus the 4 decision-time account features

synthetic_contract_fixture.description: 20-state deterministic mixed fixture where own_return_1h and account leverage jointly gate the synthetic target direction
